newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico peso ends mixed, mkt tracks U.S. long bond.
newsitem.headline: Mexico peso ends mixed, mkt tracks U.S. long bond.

text.p: Mexican peso contracts finished mixed on Friday after zigzagging on the back of changing U.S. long bond yields, dealers said.
"The peso wavered between 7.7550 and 7.7750 entirely on speculative dealing over the U.S. long bond and the Dow (Jones)," a trader said.
The benchmark 48-hour peso ended the session unchanged at 7.7600/7.7650 per dollar, while its 24-hour stablemate ended 0.6 of a centavo weaker, at 7.7580/7.7610 per dollar.
Same-day peso contracts had closed trade mid-morning 0.75 of a centavo firmer at 7.7490/7.7520 per dollar.
The U.S. 30-year Treasury bond moderated an early slide of 26/32 to a decline of 5/32 in late trade to a yield of 6.56 percent.
